node.acceptance_condition: Returns 4–6 numbered example sketches, each naming the example in plain words plus one sentence of significance; total at most 250 words; only widely recognizable examples; no obscure references and no citations.
node.expected_contribution: The concrete examples that make the essay's argument vivid and self-contained.
node.objective: Assemble 4–6 concrete, widely recognizable illustrations a general educated reader will know or immediately grasp, drawn both from the kitsch tradition (such as mass-market sentimental painting, greeting-card verse, velvet-Elvis decor) and from current AI image culture (such as formulaic AI images flooding stock and print-on-demand sites, AI images winning art contests, the prompt-as-wish dynamic), each with one sentence stating what it shows about AI art and kitsch.
node.rationale: A standalone essay for a general reader needs concrete texture so its abstractions land; this child supplies the illustrative evidence the parent can deploy without external sources.
